They span six categories: general app health (retention, crashes), engagement (DAU, session length), revenue (ARPU, LTV), user experience (load time, rage taps), marketing (CAC, attribution), and app store optimization (ratings, keyword rankings). Tracking the right 10 matters more than tracking 50.
